paragraphs: Levi bar Ḥayta (end of Mo'ed Katan), and R. Yose bar Ḥanina. In Midrash Behar, chapter 33: R. Yehoshua bar Neḥemyah and R. Abba, in R. Ḥiyya bar Abba's name. This is a scribal error and should read R. Abba, son of R. Ḥiyya bar Abba. In Rabbah, Naso, chapter 11: R. Abba, son of R. Ḥiyya bar Abba. That account in Lekh Lekha, chapter 39, has Levi bar Havit—a scribal error. In Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ellu Ne'emarin: R. Yose and R. Berekhya.
